{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABa8QIAQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhEhtoQ", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 111, "title": "Investigate FreeDOS(98) HDI boot hang and '?' screen using rights-cleared, local-only game media", "body": "## Problem

A user testing a privately held PC-98 HDD image named `aliceY3.hdi` in the browser's **PC-9821Ap DOS** profile, mounted as **IDE · HDI boot**, reports a reproducible progression through the recent i486 compatibility milestones:

- Initial missing `0F 20` / `0F 22` control-register operations, protected-mode PE, STR/LTR, CLTS, paging, and IRETD VM86 transitions were addressed by [#97](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/97) through [#109](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/109) and their merged PRs.
- Latest behavior after [PR #110](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/110): the guest displays **`FREEDOS(98) FAT KERNEL GO!`**, then the text display becomes filled with repeated **`?` glyphs**. The emulator continues to show **`Running`**, but pressing Enter does not visibly change the screen.
- No emulator host error was reported at that stage. **`Running` does not prove that the DOS kernel has made forward progress.**

This may be a FreeDOS(98) boot-loader -> kernel handoff, HDD BIOS geometry/read, guest memory/CPU/interrupt, font/text-VRAM rendering, or guest software/version problem. **Do not guess which without observing execution and the raw text-VRAM bytes.** The same `FAT KERNEL GO!` stage is known in historic DOS boot troubleshooting, but the exact source/version and cause of this `?` display remain unverified.

**Distinctive rendering clue:** the emulator's [`src/font.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/src/font.rs) returns a question-mark-like *fallback glyph* for unsupported characters; [`src/bus.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/src/bus.rs) renders from separate PC-98 text/attribute VRAM. Consequently, a screen full of `?` is **not proof that the guest printed ASCII question marks**.

## Expected outcome

Move beyond fixing isolated i486 opcodes: run a **bounded end-to-end HDD boot compatibility investigation**, preferably against **lawfully obtained local-only media**, isolate the first divergence and fix all **cohesive, evidenced** problems necessary to reach a usable DOS shell and, where legally possible, start and interact with the relevant DOS game. Use small, original independently reproducible CPU/device/BIOS/rendering regression fixtures to prove each code change. Re-run the full native + production-Wasm browser suite and document honest compatibility outcomes and remaining blockers.

The **target is useful guest progress**, not a patch that hides `?`, identifies a filename, fabricates a DOS prompt, or forces a guest to skip initialization. If reaching the target requires a separate substantial, independently scoped subsystem, identify it, open a linked English `task` Issue, and leave unresolved compatibility explicitly recorded. A partial PR must **not claim the HDD boots or that this Issue is fully resolved**.

### Rights, adult content, and private-only acquisition

The user believes the media may contain an **adult-rated, formerly commercial AliceSoft title**. AliceSoft's [official Free Distribution Declaration](https://www.alicesoft.com/about/#cont08) lists **`アリスの館3`** among eligible titles, but the company retains copyright, imposes conditions (including not distributing AliceSoft-brand titles to under-18s, and including the declaration when redistributing), and the declaration **does not automatically authorize every third-party prepared HDI**. Original game distribution, bootable HDI compilation, FreeDOS kernel/shell, fonts, drivers, utilities and any bundled third-party programs must be checked **separately**. The filename `aliceY3.hdi` has **not** been matched conclusively to a specific rights-cleared source or verified archive.

**The implementer should try to identify the exact image provenance, authorized download location and applicable terms early in the investigation.** If a distributor actually permits retrieval and the implementer's legal/age/org/runtime rules allow access, the implementer **may download a lawfully offered HDI or legally reconstruct an equivalent disk** in an **ephemeral or private local workspace outside the Git checkout and all public artifact paths**, solely for compatibility testing. Do not bypass age gates, access restrictions, authentication or provider terms; never assume that a freely downloadable file is redistributable. If this cannot be verified, **do not download it**; continue with the repository's legally redistributable FreeDOS(98) fixtures and independent test guests and report that private-media validation was unavailable.

**Absolute exclusion:** do **not** add, commit, stage, push, attach, share through GitHub Issues/PRs/reviews, upload to CI/Artifacts, include in Pages/web builds, or distribute the HDI/ZIP, game resources or adult images/audio, saved data, proprietary ROM/font/BIOS dumps, full memory dumps, long traces or proprietary guest disassembly. Add or confirm `.gitignore` exclusion as necessary, but store media **outside the repository** by default. Avoid forwarding private binaries to external services. Any downloaded media is local to that permitted implementation environment, not assumed persistent or available to other agents. Use only a **brief noncopyrighted technical summary** in PRs (CPU state, offsets/sector counts, symptoms, changed behavior); do not publish explicit adult screenshots/content. Preserve the unmodified original privately and test a separate working copy.

Relevant public evidence (informational, **not proof of rights to this exact HDI**):
- AliceSoft official rights terms: https://www.alicesoft.com/about/#cont08
- A third-party [PC-98 Alice no Yakata 3 overview](https://github.com/kichikuou/patton) notes that a separately built bootable HDD uses FreeDOS(98), so a compiled HDI can contain rights/versions beyond the AliceSoft game; **do not copy its emulator core or treat its assets as licensed automatically**.
- The project [FreeDOS(98) licensing/provenance](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/licenses.md) and [DOS compatibility guide](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/dos-compatibility.md).

## Investigation plan

1. **Establish a baseline and acquisition status.** Record the exact `main` SHA, Ap profile, HDI header geometry/capacity, disk signature/partition/FAT metadata and whether this is the exact image the user tested. Acquire locally *only after* source, rights and age/access conditions pass. If inaccessible, mark that fact; do not pretend to have performed a game retest.
2. **Find the first bad transition.** Use the existing native headless `--ap` diagnostics with a bounded step budget, e.g. `cargo run --locked --release --bin headless -- /private/local/aliceY3.hdi 20000000 trace --ap` (replace the private path). Add opt-in **bounded, CPU-only** progress indicators (unique CS:EIP count/repeat rate, mode/VM/PG flags, faults, IRQ/PIT, IDE sector count/status and BIOS INT calls), where safe. Handle the `Running`/infinite-loop case even when there is no host error. Never publish complete private traces.
3. **Separate rendering from boot failure.** Inspect **raw** text-VRAM character/high bytes and attributes in the PC-98 text planes, GDC enable/start positions and graphics overlay. Determine whether literal ASCII `0x3F` is written, unsupported ANK/JIS glyphs are displayed as fallback `?`, or guest memory/text VRAM is corrupted. Design a legal original guest rendering regression for any identified bug; do not fix by replacing all unknown text with spaces.
4. **Check FreeDOS(98) boot invariants.** Observe the `FAT KERNEL GO!` handoff: sector read addresses/results, HDI/IDE geometry and LBA/CHS, IPL/BPB/FAT integrity, loading destination and size, expected CS:IP/stack, A20/extended memory, real/protected/VM86 transitions, interrupt/timer delivery and eventual DOS kernel/FreeCOM startup. Compare against *specifications and authorized FreeDOS(98) source*, not ported emulator code. Contrast the repository's known-working GPL FreeDOS floppy and original IDE/HDI probes to narrow divergence.
5. **If legally and operationally allowed, perform black-box differential validation** with a known compatible PC-98 emulator using the same privately held image solely as a reference for **observable** boot behavior, without importing/copying its implementation. Ideally establish whether the original image reaches a DOS prompt there, and which startup configuration or game command is needed. A lack of that capability must be documented rather than used as a merge gate.
6. **Fix in coherent batches, then re-run.** Address reproducible CPU, PC-98 BIOS/device, FDC/IDE, GDC/text/ANK or DOS compatibility defects found by the trace; make deterministic independent legal fixtures and tests for every correction. Retest boot to a responsive prompt, keyboard response and game launch/interaction where lawful media are available; distinguish genuine guest progress from a changed display with the same stuck CPU.

## Reproduction reported by the user

1. Open `https://takahirox.github.io/pc98-rust/` at the revision after PR #110.
2. Select `PC-9821Ap DOS`; mount `aliceY3.hdi` as `IDE · HDI boot`; reset/boot.
3. Display reaches `FREEDOS(98) FAT KERNEL GO!`, then fills with question-mark-like glyphs. Browser UI remains `Running`.
4. Enter produces no visible change. No host error message reported.

The user has not supplied a screenshot, actual binary, file hash, FreeDOS version, or proof that this prepared HDI contains only AliceSoft-declared material. **Do not invent these details.**

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Investigate the actual public license terms and available provenance for `aliceY3.hdi` and its *components*, record exact permitted actions and unknowns, and take a **lawful-access decision** before any download. If the exact image cannot be lawfully accessed by the implementation environment, record *not obtained/not retested*, proceed with redistributable fixtures and avoid pretending otherwise. This is an investigation requirement, not a requirement to acquire age-gated or inaccessible media.
- [ ] Run an **independent, legal FreeDOS(98) HDD/boot regression** (or produce one using the repository's already-cleared GPL FreeDOS inputs and original MIT helpers) capturing kernel handoff, responsive DOS prompt/keyboard, and relevant IDE/BIOS/VRAM evidence without proprietary media. Ensure meaningful failure-before/pass-after checks for any diagnosed defect, not only a successful boot greeting.
- [ ] Add bounded, opt-in diagnostics/observations capable of identifying no-host-error hangs and distinguishing actual `?` character bytes from fallback font rendering. Validate CPU loop/fault/interrupt and IDE/disk state with independent guest tests; never emit whole copyrighted disk contents, large memory dumps or actual adult content.
- [ ] Implement and regression-test **the concrete reproducible underlying defects** found in the boot path, honoring original Rust-only CPU/device implementation and PC-98 hardware semantics. Do not add guest-specific workarounds. Fix related defects as a coherent unit; record separate substantial blockers as linked `task` Issues instead of speculative sweeping rewrites.
- [ ] Where **verified and legitimately accessible** to the implementer, perform local-only, nonpublished **real-HD I boot and input validation**: observe transition beyond `FAT KERNEL GO!`, whether repeated `?` remains, whether DOS reaches a responsive shell, and optionally game startup/interaction, without publishing the image or adult content. State the exact result honestly. **No specific private HDI, human gameplay, remote adult-media download or adult age/access verification is a mandatory pre-merge gate.**
- [ ] For any changed emulator code, pass and report documented fixture preparation/license checks, `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, production Rust/Wasm build and publication audit, and real-Wasm Chromium tests at both `/` and `/pc98-rust/`, cold/reset. The private HDD must be absent from CI and public browser assets; the original guest executes in Rust, not fabricated by host JavaScript.
- [ ] Publish **only noncopyrighted technical notes** explaining baseline, the first independently established divergence, before/after results of legal regression fixtures, final capability limits and the actual local-image retest status. Explicitly say if game boot/playability was **not confirmed**. No emulator core reuse/copying, commercial software assets, NEC proprietary dumps, or adult screenshots enter Git/CI/Pages.
- [ ] A PR claiming `Closes this Issue` must actually satisfy its **investigation and reproducible bug-fix** criteria; a partial implementation should leave the source Issue open or establish a clear linked continuation. Do not claim a target game's boot is fixed if that result was not measured. Avoid blocking legitimate partial progress on unavailable private media.

**All mandatory pre-merge checks must be independently AI-executable with legally redistributable fixtures.** Private-media retests, physical hardware, manual game interaction, live deployed Pages and checks only possible after merge must **never** become pre-merge approval requirements. See [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md) and [review guidelines](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md).

## Optional validation

A lawfully acquired, local-only `aliceY3.hdi` boot to interactive DOS and game launch, optionally compared to a reference emulator as a **black box**, with only text-based, noncopyrighted CPU/device observations shared publicly. If the implementer cannot obtain lawful access, this is explicitly **not performed**; do not fabricate a PASS or ask the user to upload adult material.

## Required post-merge verification

None. Any truly deployment-only follow-up should become a separate `task` Issue; do not add a live Pages or human-verified game check as a pre-merge blocker.
